final: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS sum_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND player_id IS NOT NULL) AND player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE round = 'WS' AND player_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY (SUM(triple) IS NULL), SUM(triple) DESC LIMIT 10
